en.subject: Accommodation Options for Our Wedding Weekend 🌿💍
en.intro1: We are so excited to celebrate our special day with you on October 3rd, 2026! Thank you for confirming your attendance — it means the world to us to have you there.
en.intro2: To make your planning easier, we've put together a list of nearby accommodation options for your stay. Whether you're looking for glamping, a charming hostel or a castle hotel, we've got you covered!

details: Small hotel in the medieval town of Cardona.

accommodations.name: Parador de Cardona
details: Stunning castle hotel overlooking Cardona.
accommodations.address: Castell de Cardona, s/n, 08261 Cardona, Barcelona

accommodations.name: AT Cardona
details: Tourist apartments in the village of Cardona.

accommodations.name: Ramon Park Hotel
details: Hotel in a natural park setting near Santpedor.
accommodations.address: Camí de Juncadella s/n, 08251 Santpedor, Barcelona

accommodations.name: Dom Bosco
details: Rustic masia with modern amenities in Castellnou de Bages.
accommodations.address: Plaça l'Església, s/n, 08251 Castellnou de Bages, Barcelona

accommodations.name: Hostal Somnis
details: Cozy hostel nearby.

accommodations.name: Restaurant Hostel Ca Fuster
details: Charming mini castle experience.
accommodations.address: Carrer Cal Fuster s/n, 08673 Viver i Serrateix, Barcelona

accommodations.name: Casa Albareda
details: Rural estate with pool, tennis court and full amenities.

accommodations.name: Camping Hostalet
details: Glamping bungalows available — a unique and fun option!

accommodations.name: La Prensa Hotel Rural
details: Historic rural hotel and restaurant in Cardona.

en.helpText: Please let us know if you need help booking or have any questions. We're happy to assist in any way we can!
en.closing: We can't wait to celebrate with all of you. It's going to be magical!
